GenAiPromptTemplate.description: With the unstructured address for a customer, transform it into a structured JSON format

templateVersions.content:
Unstructured address: {!$Input:Raw_Address}
""" - Standardize and convert the unstructured address into JSON formatted output with following fields: "Street", "City", "State", "ZipCode", "Country" - Avoid using abbreviations in the field values - Respond only with a JSON structured output and nothing else - If you are unable to confidently parse this address, respond only with the field "Issue" with a value that briefly describes in 1 sentence why you were unable to parse the address - All fields must be populated """
